source.title: AMI Meeting Corpus ES2003b (scenario design meeting, session b, functional design)
source.attribution: See NOTICE.md in the parent directory.

action_items.text: Industrial Designer (Speaker_4) will look into a speaker, an LED and a transmitter for locating the lost remote.
action_items.quote: So I should just look at um the speaker, the speaker and an L_E_D_.

action_items.text: Marketing Expert (Speaker_1) is asked to find out what people think of the minimalist joystick-plus-display approach.
action_items.quote: see what people think about the idea of this minimalist approach that we've taken, where of a joystick to control the very basic functions

decisions.text: The LCD will be black and white rather than colour, to keep unit cost down.
decisions.quote: most of the mobile phone displays you see these days are colour but we should probably try to stick to black and white.

decisions.text: The remote will include a locate-me feature: a transmitter attached to the TV makes the remote beep (with a speaker, possibly an LED).
decisions.quote: So that would require a um transmitter maybe attached to the T_V_, just so that it says find me

notes: Few crisp commitments: this is a functional-design meeting that mostly floats ideas, and the wrap-up assigns only two tasks (Industrial Designer on locate hardware, Marketing Expert on user opinion of the minimalist approach). Deliberately left out: dropping voice recognition and the macro facility (the PM only voiced doubts), TV-only scope (a pre-existing requirement), joystick direction mappings, and the slogan/logo placement (soft, unassigned). The 'minimal remote' design direction was dropped as only a rough idea; the black-and-white LCD and locate-me decisions are hedged ('probably', 'maybe') but each is agreed by another participant or assigned as follow-up work.
